title: Signatures Profile Removal
lede: Signed athletes now stay focused on the one job at the signature station: save the private signature, see a brief confirmation, and return to the roster.

stats.n: Same Football roster and signed-player data

sections.heading: Matched roster comparison
sections.note: Production before and authenticated local Preview after use the same live Football roster, same account, same browser, same viewport, and same first signed-player action menu.

pairs.title: Signed player row and actions
pairs.beforeCap: Production asks for a second website-profile task and exposes Edit athlete profile.
pairs.afterCap: Local Preview removes both profile signals while preserving signature Quick Look and replacement actions.

changes.h: Capture had a second workflow after commit
changes.was: A player save opened a website-profile form, while the roster kept warning that a profile was needed.
changes.now: A committed save changes the action to Saved with a restrained check animation, then replaces the capture history entry with the roster.

changes.h: Profile data leaked into the capture contract
changes.was: Detail and bootstrap responses exposed profile completeness and fields, and a Signatures-only mutation route could update them.
changes.now: The UI, response fields, mutation route, service, validation schema, and permission are removed. Existing database columns remain dormant and untouched.

changes.h: A post-commit navigation failure could lie
changes.was: An exception after commit could fall into generic save-failure feedback.
changes.now: Committed state remains Saved, repeat save is disabled, and the operator gets a truthful manual roster-return message.

verification: 104 focused Signature tests pass across capture, cache, route, service, storage, and ZIP behavior.
TypeScript, ESLint, and build:app pass; Next generated all 245 pages and the deleted profile API route is absent from the route inventory.
Authenticated local Preview: 0 Profile needed labels and no Edit athlete profile action on the same roster where Production has 112 labels and the action.
Console: no errors on either matched roster page.
notes: The save animation was not triggered against live roster data because that would replace a real private signature artifact. Its state ordering, reduced-motion timing, direct roster navigation, and post-commit failure fallback are covered by focused source contracts; physical iPad and Apple Pencil acceptance remains open.
This is local source and authenticated Preview proof only. The profile removal and save feedback are not committed, deployed, or production-verified.
